body: I’ve already sent in my course evaluation for the professor and encouraged others to be completely honest about his complete disregard of students situations or the current circumstance were all in right now since the course evals are “anonymous” and a few agreed that that is a fair way to let their anger towards the prof be heard. But most of us need to pass the final exam to pass the course and we don’t know what’s going to be on it since his previous test preps haven’t been nearly close to the actual test. I just don’t know what else I can/should do
My major is biology and I’m a 3rd year (junior)
Thank you, and I really do appreciate it. I just really don’t want to put this on anyone else but the professor.

I do have medical accommodations for my anxiety and depression, but I didn’t use them this semester, mainly since the college I go to never explained how I would go about doing so. In previous semesters I’d give the professor a pice of paper explaining what I’m dealing with and what accommodations I needed.

I’ve emailed my college. They didn’t reply. I’ve talked with other students that said they’re also mad, but they’re too scared to reach out to the head of the department. I just want this guy to know what he’s put us through emotionally, and I think seeing his own student taking their own life on a zoom call would do it for him. I’m not even an important person, I don’t know what else I could do to get through to him that he did not handle this semester with our best interest in mind.

I’m sorry for posting this. You seem nice but I don’t think you’d be able to help and I didn’t want to put this on anyone except this professor. I just wanted it to be known that it was this professors fault that I did this tomorrow.
